messages:
Alex M: Heads up — FinServ (Lina) scheduled a POC next week. They require EU-only data residency for the POC, BYOK with an EU KMS, and explicit no-US-access rules for the POC window. They also want the full subprocessor list and routing proofs (tenant pinning, egress IPs). Also asked for delta pricing for Dedicated vs Hosted. Who can advise on ops/security/pricing? cc @Priya @Marta-Sec

Priya S: I can take tech presales. Quick question — is the customer asking for hard tenant pinning (no cross-border failover) or is a preferred region OK? Hard pin changes how we handle fallback and fallthrough.

Lina (FinServ): Hard pin required. No cross-border transfers during the POC period. They want routing traces and a list of egress IPs to validate with their network team.

Marta-Sec: We'll need to run our security questionnaire and provide a subprocessor attestation + GDPR annex. We can commit to EU-only control plane + EU KMS for the POC, and provide audited access logs. We can't wholesale promise zero access by US personnel, but we can add contractual restrictions and admin controls for the POC.

Tom-Legal: Clarify: when they say 'no US access' do they mean (A) no data egress to US or (B) no US-based personnel with access? We can offer a POC addendum limiting personnel jurisdictions and data flow for the POC duration, but need exact ask to scope contract changes.

Jared N: On routing: we can tenant-pin and advertise egress only from eu-west-1. For strict enforcement we should set fallback=deny in the routing policy so requests can't fall through to other regions. Example (ops config stub):
```
policy: tenant_pin
regions: [eu-west-1]
fallback: deny
preferred_egress_ips: [34.120.45.23, 35.198.12.7]
```
We'll need an ops ticket to lock this down and provision network ACLs and public IPs.

Alex M: Priya — can you estimate pricing delta for a 2-week POC with ~50k tokens/day? They asked for Hosted vs Dedicated and an uplift if BYOK + Dedicated required.

Priya S: Rough back-of-envelope: Hosted + EU KMS + routing controls (no pin) — minimal onboarding, standard hosted pricing + KMS fees. Dedicated short-term for strict pinning + BYOK — expect a 2–4x per-token delta for small short-term commits due to provisioning overhead; BYOK onboarding / HSM/key management support — one-time ~${2}k–${5}k engineering/setup fee for a POC (ballpark). I'll get a formal quote.

Priya S: Ops flow I recommend:
1) Create eu-only tenant with pin=true
2) Attach customer KMS key (EU region) and validate key policy
3) Provision routing policy with fallback: deny and publish egress IPs
4) Provide subproc/export and log retention details to customer
I'll open the provisioning ticket now.

deploy-bot: POC env requested: ticket #POC-789 opened by @Priya S. Status: provisioning.

Priya S: Routing test steps (draft to share with FinServ):
1) curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <POC_KEY>' https://api.redwood.example/generate -v -> confirm Host resolves to eu-west-1 and TLS cert CN eu-west-1.redwood.example
2) traceroute to the resolved host and confirm egress IPs match published list
3) call KMS DescribeKey and confirm key Arn/ID includes eu region prefix and key policy denies non-eu principals
4) check control plane logs for request IP and user principal during the test window

Marta-Sec: Add to that — we need KMS and control-plane access logs for the POC window, and proof of log retention. Also export the subprocessors CSV with datacenter/country columns.

Lina (FinServ): Also can you confirm SOC2 and ISO27001? And list any subprocessors located in US — they want names to check against their policy.

Tom-Legal: I'll prepare a DPA + POC Addendum that limits processing locale and personnel jurisdiction for the POC timeframe. We'll include subprocessor list (redacted contact info) and the standard security cert pack.

Alex M: Great. Priya — can you assemble an email bundle to Lina with: routing test steps, rough pricing, the subprocessor list, and a short runbook for KMS attach? Target EOD today. Marta/Tom — can you review before send? :pray: 

Priya S: On it. I'll post the draft here in ~3h.

Jared N: One operational note — if BYOK requires cert/key rotation or HSM provisioning we might need a maintenance window; suggest we coordinate times with the customer's network/security ops to avoid false positives.

deploy-bot: POC-789 update — eu-tenant created (staging), pending KMS attach and routing lock. Current status: pending action from @Priya S and @Marta-Sec.

Alex M: Thanks team — keeping Lina in the loop. Lina, we'll follow up with the formal quote and POC addendum.

Lina (FinServ): Thanks — looking forward to the bundle. Please include the egress IPs and the timeline for KMS attach.

(End of thread)
